district.label: Your district's policies (volunteer screening, field trips, risk management)

requirements.title: Student–employer communication norms
requirements.description: Students reach out from their school email with a teacher copied. Conversations happen by phone, video or in a public place, never through private social media messages.

requirements.title: Event details confirmed
requirements.description: Date, time, room, parking and who meets the guest at the front office.

requirements.title: Campus visitor sign-in
requirements.description: Guests on campus follow the school's visitor check-in (usually ID at the front office). A staff member stays with the guest the whole time.

requirements.title: Site visit / field trip approval
requirements.description: District field trip approval for taking students off campus, including transportation plan.

requirements.title: Parent/guardian permission slips
requirements.description: Signed permission for each student under 18 for any off-campus or employer-supervised activity, with emergency contacts.

requirements.title: Worksite safety checklist
requirements.description: Employer confirms safe areas for students, required safety gear, and areas students may not enter. Students may not do hazardous tasks restricted for minors.

requirements.title: Mentor / project partner agreement
requirements.description: One-page agreement covering goals, schedule, communication through school channels (no private one-on-one messaging), and who to call with concerns.

requirements.title: District volunteer screening / background check
requirements.description: Many Colorado districts require volunteer screening for adults who work with students repeatedly or without a staff member present. Check your district's policy and who pays.

requirements.title: Work-based learning training agreement
requirements.description: Signed by school, employer, student and parent: learning goals, schedule, supervisor, evaluation, and how concerns are raised.

requirements.title: Workers' compensation coverage decided
requirements.description: Paid students are usually covered by the employer's policy. For unpaid, school-sponsored training, Colorado law may treat the student as covered by the sponsoring school district unless the district and employer agree otherwise. Confirm in writing.

requirements.title: Certificate of liability insurance
requirements.description: Employer's general liability certificate, if your district requires it. Many districts list required minimums in their risk management policy.

requirements.title: Youth employment hours and tasks reviewed
requirements.description: If a student is paid, Colorado limits hours for minors (e.g., no more than 40 hours a week or 8 hours in 24 hours; extra limits for under-16s on school days and late evenings) and bans some hazardous tasks. Review the schedule and duties against CDLE guidance.

requirements.title: Age certificate / work permit (if applicable)
requirements.description: Colorado's youth employment law references work permits and age certificates. Check with CDLE guidance and your district whether one is needed for this student and placement.

requirements.title: Paid or unpaid decided correctly
requirements.description: Unpaid placements with for-profit employers must meet the federal 'primary beneficiary' test. Micro-internships and formal internships are usually paid. When in doubt, pay at least Colorado (or local) minimum wage.
